entities.name: Query PEPC
observations: 768 aa protein sequence; predicted molecular mass 85.96 kDa and pI 5.63.
Contains a strong PEPcase Pfam domain (PF00311.24) spanning residues 8–768.
Matches reviewed Pseudomonas aeruginosa PEPC Q9HXV3 at 100% identity and 100% query coverage; E-value 0.
Sequence-based assignment supports phosphoenolpyruvate carboxylase activity, but the query itself has no direct experimental annotation in this analysis.

entities.name: Q9HXV3 PEPC
observations: Annotated with EC 4.1.1.31 and magnesium ion cofactor.
Annotated to cytosol, carbon fixation, oxaloacetate metabolism, and tricarboxylic acid cycle.

entities.name: PEPC carboxylation reaction
observations: Reaction direction as represented in the database: oxaloacetate + phosphate = phosphoenolpyruvate + hydrogencarbonate. The physiological forward carboxylation direction is phosphoenolpyruvate + hydrogencarbonate = oxaloacetate + phosphate.

entities.name: Mg2+ cofactor
observations: Reviewed PEPC homologs are annotated to require Mg2+ for catalysis or substrate binding.
